response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine staff-level breadth—distributed, high-throughput systems experience (Dunnhumby's millions-of-requests-per-second infrastructure), strong TypeScript, and current hands-on work building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP-based developer tooling, which directly matches the AI-native mindset the role demands. However, there is no evidence of Python anywhere in his skills or project history despite it being an explicit must-have, and his non-technical evidence for formal stakeholder management, incident response/on-call ownership, and agile ceremony participation is thin or implicit rather than demonstrated.
strengths: Direct current experience building AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow frameworks—rare and highly relevant nice-to-have
Proven distributed/high-throughput systems background (Dunnhumby: microservices handling millions of HTTP requests/sec, low-latency async I/O work)
Broad polyglot systems thinking across web, embedded, mobile, and backend, plus founder/teaching experience showing strong ownership mindset
concerns: No mention of Python anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being an explicit must-have technical requirement
Little explicit evidence of formal stakeholder management across product/leadership or structured agile/scrum ceremony experience
No clear mention of on-call/incident-response ownership or operational monitoring responsibilities in prior roles
